title: T05c — Mac operating-conditions report
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures; do not send private inputs to another inference host or enable services/devices without existing authorization.
acceptance: Record office/heavy, home/active/moderate and home/overnight/minimal conditions with actual workload/resource observations; time/location labels alone are insufficient
Hold model/runtime/settings/cases/grader and total comparison budgets equivalent; distinguish fresh cold/warm telemetry from reused functional evidence
Report task/critical outcomes, latency, resource pressure, token cost and owner desktop impact; unsupported metrics remain unknown
Select exact campaign cases/repeats/total time-token budgets before execution; no model execution or scheduling is authorized by the plan
Mini PC has one normal baseline; only T04 placement-specific inference/tools-test contention and Mac dependency recovery require separate bounded checks
Reference released Gauntlet machine/scenario definitions and evidence identity; NERV retains assignments and role acceptance, not duplicate generic schemas
validation: Review scenario/configuration identity, comparable budgets and fresh measured telemetry
Run applicable work/backlog/doc checks; distinguish planning from executed load evidence
escalation: Stop on unclear ownership, missing prerequisites, privacy changes or uncertain external effects
Escalate repeated tool failures or inadequate context; no automatic cloud fallback

effort.basis: Owner-approved slice, 2026-11-11 (PR #264). Slice T05c of the step "Compare Mac heavy, moderate and idle operating conditions". Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 0.75 hours agent; former 0.5-day estimate at 1.5 agent hours per focused day. Method: a judged rate of about 1.5 agent hours per former focused day, not a calculation, informed by NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge, a throughput proxy: median about 0.56 h, p75 2.1–2.7 h by quantile method, p90 about 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement); a step that is a PR of its own takes at least 0.75 h with review and CI, while an agent part that only prepares or records for an owner step may be less. Machine time of real-model or device runs is not counted. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 0.5 kept as history. Re-estimated 2026-11-12 at 0.6x from `work-items calibrate` (median 0.55x over 6 closed steps; bug steps 0.6x over 5): 0.75 h → 0.5 h, min 0.5 h; owner hours and baseline kept. Estimate column backfilled 2026-11-12 at harness 7.0.0: estimateAgentHours = remaining plus actual so far (0.5 h); the baseline stays for calibration.
